fields.name: title
fields.description: Name of the client organization featured in the case study. In the top left of the image.

fields.name: project_description
examples: Enhancing Cloud Security with XYZ Platform
fields.description: The description of the project's objective or outcome. In the image it exactly below the client name

fields.name: industry
fields.description: The industry to which the client belongs.

fields.name: geo
fields.description: The geographical region where the client operates or where the project took place.

fields.name: deal_size
fields.description: The monetary value of the deal between the client and the service provider.

fields.name: deal_closed
fields.description: The quarter and year in which the deal was closed.

fields.name: ibm_sales_play
fields.description: The IBM sales initiative or theme (if applicable) tied to the project.

fields.name: products_services
fields.description: The IBM or partner products and services involved in the solution.

fields.name: business_partner
fields.description: The partner organization collaborating with IBM on the engagement.

fields.name: competitors
fields.description: Mention of any competitors involved or considered for the project.

fields.name: team
fields.description: Name of the IBM or partner team member leading or involved in the engagement.

fields.name: client_website
fields.description: Official website of the client organization.

fields.name: client_overview
examples: Global Bank Corp is a multinational financial services firm with operations in over 150 countries and more than 200 million customers.
fields.description: Brief description of the client organization, its operations, and scale.

fields.name: business_need
examples: Client needed a scalable cloud infrastructure to support global e-commerce operations with improved latency and resilience.
fields.description: Summary of the primary business challenge or need that led to the engagement.

fields.name: winning_tactics
examples: Leveraged deep expertise in hybrid cloud and regulatory compliance to deliver a customized architecture meeting global standards.
fields.description: Details on how the service provider approached and won the client engagement.

fields.name: client_benefits
examples: Improved scalability, 40% reduction in downtime, enhanced compliance with international data protection laws.
fields.description: Tangible or strategic benefits the client received from the implementation.

document.document_description: A Client Success Case Study is a business document highlighting a successful collaboration between a client and a service provider, showcasing business challenges, implemented solutions, and resulting benefits.
document.additional_prompt_instructions:
Special instructions: 
- For the business_need field return all the text below until the fields client_benefits and winning_tactics
- For the client_benefits field return all the text below until the end of the page

- For the winning_tactics field return all the text below until the end of the page

Important anchor/fields mapping setting:
Always set the field mapping of 'title' to "Industry"
